rows.evidence: Biblical eLearning's George Whitefield page lists 'Sermon 8: The Necessity and Benefits of Religious Society (Eccles. 4:9-12) (45 mins) Audio mp3' linking to this player page (Whitefield_Necessity_of_Religious_Society_Sermon8.mp3, 45 min). This is the later title of the same first sermon: its compiled text says it will show 'the necessity and benefits of society in general, and of religious society in particular', and 9Marks identifies it as the sermon of 27 June 1736.

I found no legitimate free recording. Biblical eLearning's 59-sermon audio set has an empty, audio-less entry where this sermon ('On Regeneration', Sermon 49) should be, LibriVox's Whitefield author page lists only The Method of Grace, and searches turned up text copies only.
